fact: Senegal's education ministry describes SIMEN, a renewed unified education information system, as being built, with four components including software engineering and infrastructure.
The ministry says a unique identifier (IEN) is attributed to each education staff member and to pupils, teachers and parents, and gives access to the information system.
The SIMEN coordinator says the education ministry built in-house an ecosystem of 41 platforms under its integrated management system SIMEN, being deployed nationwide, all feeding one data warehouse.

The SIMEN coordinator says the ministry enrols pupils, teachers and other actors and gives each a unique national education identifier, which sets the platforms each one sees, while the 41 platforms are still being deployed across the country.
